description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger queries. Should-trigger covers a README for a reusable package or library: install, minimal usage, compatibility (EN + DE phrasings). Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbors: an application README (readme-writing), reviewing a README (readme-reviewer), package publishing mechanics, API reference docs, and a changelog.

queries.q: write the README for our npm package
this composer library needs a README with install and a minimal example
rewrite the library README so a developer can get started in five minutes
schreib eine README für unser Paket mit Installation und Kompatibilität
document which PHP and Laravel versions the package supports in its README
write a README for our web app repository
check this README for invented features
generate the API reference from the TypeScript types
